hypothesis_candidates.name: block_print_absorption_h10
hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: transactions+vwap give average dollar size per trade. A session where a liquid stock's average trade size is an extreme outlier vs its own trailing 126-session distribution, with confirming dollar volume and close>=open, indicates block-dominated absorption (institutional/informed accumulation) rather than retail churn; positive 10-session drift should follow.
hypothesis_candidates.new_evidence_axis: Section 2.4 axis (d): unprecedented field (transactions/vwap -> average trade size) on the unsaturated massive_full_market_ohlcv source. Ingested by quant/massive_ohlcv_backfill.py but never consumed by any experiment (verified by grep over quant/ scouts 2026-08-04).

hypothesis_candidates.name: retail_churn_avoidance_overlay
hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Collapsing average trade size (retail-dominated tape) as a negative context overlay on core entries; Barber-Odean attention crowding.
hypothesis_candidates.why_not: Entry-admission/downweight overlays on the core stack have a long rejected lineage (iBorrowDesk gate, short-volume clean-flow both ways); touch-density preflight would likely fail on ~47 names. Keep as follow-up only if the primary field shows any cross-sectional signal.

hypothesis_candidates.name: vwap_close_dislocation
hypothesis_candidates.mechanism: Close far above session vwap = late-day aggressive buying; momentum continuation.
hypothesis_candidates.why_not: Close-vs-vwap is heavily arbitraged intraday-reversal territory and overlaps existing price-only compression/breakout families; weaker novelty than the trade-size axis.

economic_mechanism: Average-trade-size outliers separate block-dominated absorption from retail churn; blocks reveal informed accumulation that diffuses into price over ~10 sessions.
